decisions.quote: TITLE: Revisiting the Effect of Internationalization on Firm Governance: A Replication and Extension Study
decisions.reason: Although the title describes the paper as a replication and extension study, the supplied source contains only the title, author metadata, an empty Abstract heading, and the reference list. Under Step 1, distinguishing a new-sample replication from an original-data reproduction or verifying that a specific published finding was empirically re-tested requires evidence of the study's data relationship, which is missing from the supplied text.

scope_review.parent_objection: Source contains only title, empty Abstract heading and publisher reference list, no empirical methods/results or named tested original. First reply certifies replication from title alone and original identity from one similarly titled reference. Step1 distinguishes new-data replication from original-data reproduction or plans; title Replication and Extension does not establish data relationship. Step2 prohibits inferring target merely from title/topic/bibliography unless exactly one citation fits the described finding. Does supplied source actually describe an original finding or identify Sanders/Carpenter as retested, or are type and identity unverified? Reassess all3fields independently using available source; do not treat absence of contradiction as confirmation or shipped/blind agreement as evidence. Outcome remains unsupported. Return explicit uncertainty where source cannot establish relationship.
